name: Edoxaban Tosylate

fda.text: (A) REDUCED EFFICACY IN NONVALVULAR ATRIAL FIBRILLATION PATIENTS WITH CREATININE CLEARANCE (CRCL) > 95 ML/MIN (B) PREMATURE DISCONTINUATION OF SAVAYSA INCREASES THE RISK OF ISCHEMIC EVENTS (C) SPINAL/EPIDURAL HEMATOMA WARNING: (A) REDUCED EFFICACY IN NONVALVULAR ATRIAL FIBRILLATION PATIENTS WITH CREATININE CLEARANCE…

5 WARNINGS AND PRECAUTIONS Bleeding: Serious and potentially fatal bleeding. Promptly evaluate signs and symptoms of blood loss ( 5.3 ) Mechanical Heart Valves or Moderate to Severe Mitral Stenosis: Use is not recommended ( 5.5 ) Increased Risk of Thrombosis in Patients with Triple Positive Antiphospholipid Syndrome:…

summary: Edoxaban Tosylate carries the FDA's strongest type of boxed warning regarding reduced effectiveness in certain irregular heartbeat patients, an increased risk of blood-flow-blocking events if stopped early, and bleeding near the spine called spinal or epidural hematoma [3]. Additional warnings alert to serious or potentially fatal bleeding, state it is not recommended for people with mechanical heart valves or moderate to severe narrowing of the heart's mitral valve, and note an increased risk of blood clots in patients with triple positive antiphospholipid syndrome [3]. Furthermore, risk scores from a small computer model rather than human tests placed liver risks in a high category and heart risks in a low category [M].
